answer.original_source: NN, Inc. (company announcement, reported by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01)
answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity said to be pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and a 2026 target of US$80-90 million of new business. The figures are company-stated with no capex size, no NVIDIA confirmation, and no shipment data. The period is 2026 for the business target and undated for the capacity. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a third-party narrative (US$485.5m/US$47.9m) and an unnamed-analyst rumour (US$489.5m/US$48.3m), neither of which is an NVDA figure. The Russell Microcap Value removal is a fact about NN's index membership, not NVDA.
answer.reason: No questions_to_consider, stored_pieces or catalog entries exist, so there is no existing NVDA argument to update. The record concerns a supplier (NN, Inc.) rather than NVIDIA itself. Its capacity claim is sizeless, company-stated and undated, and its business target is a 2026 company target, not an NVDA metric. The 2028 projections and fair value are third-party narrative or rumour, and the index removal is unrelated to NVDA. It is a pickup that moves no number, probability or condition of any NVDA question, and it does not carry an investment judgement that would change the position, so it is background only.
